messages.content: Select evidence for an explicit comparison in a Council brief. Return exactly NONE unless one of these two relations is supported: authority means the delegate describes a reporting role with the committee deciding and the adopted document sets that same division, with no recommendation from the reporting body; review means the delegate prefers a fixed-time review and the adopted document expresses an intention for continuing review. A rejected, quoted, draft, or merely similar claim does not establish either relation. Read the whole source for each speaker's actual stance. If supported, return only JSON: {"type":"authority or review","delegate":["exact span"],"document":["exact span"]}. Select one or two brief contiguous substrings per source. For authority, show the report's purpose, its lack of recommendation, and who decides. For review, show the preference, the operative verb expressing intention, and continuous timing. Use the shortest exact spans that preserve those details. Across all spans use at most 27 words. Copy the words as they occur, without altering capitalization, spelling or punctuation.
